name: Microgravity Sample Transfer and Containment Procedure
purpose: Standardized protocol for astronaut sample acquisition, container deposition, and vessel sealing in microgravity to validate sequence tracking and AI procedure monitoring.
preconditions: Sample tray with red and blue samples in initial rest position
AI perception pipeline initialized and in RUNNING state
failure_conditions: Step executed out of sequence (e.g. S3 before S1)
Action classification confidence below minimum threshold

steps.instruction: Grasp the red sample from the sample holding rack.
steps.recovery: Return hand to starting position and re-acquire the red sample.

steps.instruction: Transfer and deposit the red sample securely into the container.
steps.recovery: Retrieve red sample if dislodged and place firmly inside the container.

steps.instruction: Grasp the blue sample from the sample holding rack.
steps.recovery: Return hand to starting position and re-acquire the blue sample.

steps.instruction: Transfer and deposit the blue sample securely into the container.
steps.recovery: Retrieve blue sample if dislodged and place firmly inside the container.

steps.instruction: Align and securely close the container lid to seal the vessel.
steps.recovery: Re-align container lid and press firmly until locked.
